chapterInfo.content:
5
Adom ne mmoa ho adesrɛ
1AWURADE, kae deɛ aba yɛn soɔ,
hwɛ na hunu yɛn ahohora!
2Yɛn agyapadeɛ adane ahɔhoɔ deɛ,
yɛn afie ayɛ ananafoɔ deɛ;
3yɛadanedane nwisiaa ne nnyanka,
yɛn nanom te sɛ akunafoɔ.
4Nsuo a yɛnom, yɛtua ka,
yɛn nnyina nso, wɔtɔn ma yɛn.
5Wɔkura yɛn kɔn akyi ka yɛn kɔ,
yɛbrɛ, wɔmma yɛnnya ahomeyɛ.
6Yɛde yɛn ho ma Misraim ne Asiria,
na yɛanya aduane adi amee.
7 # Eks 20.5; Yer 31.29; Hes 18.2 Yɛn agyanom ayɛ bɔne, nso wɔnni hɔ,
na yɛn na yɛso wɔn amumuyɛ.
8Nkoa di yɛn so,
deɛ ɔbɛgye yɛn afiri wɔn nsa mu nni hɔ.
9Yɛn nkwa kurakura yɛn nsam,
na yɛkɔpɛ yɛn aduane wɔ ɛserɛ so, afena no anim.
10Yɛn wedeɛ ayɛ hyehyeehye sɛ fononoo,
ɛkɔm a ano yɛ hyeɛ no nti.
11Wɔabrɛ Sion mmaa, ne
Yuda nkuro mu mmabaa, ase.
12Wɔde wɔn nsa sensɛne mmapɔmma,
wɔnni mpanin ni.
13Wɔma mmeranteɛ yam ayuyammoɔ so,
na mmɔfra hwehwe ase nnyina ase.
14Mpanimfoɔ agyae kuro apono mu ba,
mmeranteɛ agyae wɔn sankubɔ.
15Yɛn akoma ahosan agyae,
yɛn asa adane abooboodie.
16 # Yer 13.18 Yɛn abotire ayi atɔ fam.
Yɛn ara yɛnnue, na yɛayɛ bɔne.
17Yei nti, na yɛn akoma atɔ piti,
yeinom ho na yɛn ani so ayɛ kusuu.
18Sion bepɔ a ayɛ amamfo nti,
ɛserɛ so kraman nenam so.
19Wo AWURADE, wote hɔ daa,
w’adwa tim hɔ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
20 # Dwom 13.1 Ɛdeɛn nti na wo werɛ firi yɛn ma no kyɛre saa,
na woagya yɛn dadadada yi?
21AWURADE, sane yɛn bra wo nkyɛn, na yɛnsane,
ma yɛn nna nyɛ foforɔ sɛ tete deɛ no.
22Anaasɛ poɔ na woapo yɛn koraa,
wo bo afu yɛn mmoroso?

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, kae deɛ aba yɛn soɔ,
hwɛ na hunu yɛn ahohora!
Yɛn agyapadeɛ adane ahɔhoɔ deɛ,
yɛn afie ayɛ ananafoɔ deɛ;
yɛadanedane nwisiaa ne nnyanka,
yɛn nanom te sɛ akunafoɔ.
Nsuo a yɛnom, yɛtua ka,
yɛn nnyina nso, wɔtɔn ma yɛn.
Wɔkura yɛn kɔn akyi ka yɛn kɔ,
yɛbrɛ, wɔmma yɛnnya ahomeyɛ.
Yɛde yɛn ho ma Misraim ne Asiria,
na yɛanya aduane adi amee.
Yɛn agyanom ayɛ bɔne, nso wɔnni hɔ,
na yɛn na yɛso wɔn amumuyɛ.
Nkoa di yɛn so,
deɛ ɔbɛgye yɛn afiri wɔn nsa mu nni hɔ.
Yɛn nkwa kurakura yɛn nsam,
na yɛkɔpɛ yɛn aduane wɔ ɛserɛ so, afena no anim.
Yɛn wedeɛ ayɛ hyehyeehye sɛ fononoo,
ɛkɔm a ano yɛ hyeɛ no nti.
Wɔabrɛ Sion mmaa, ne
Yuda nkuro mu mmabaa, ase.
Wɔde wɔn nsa sensɛne mmapɔmma,
wɔnni mpanin ni.
Wɔma mmeranteɛ yam ayuyammoɔ so,
na mmɔfra hwehwe ase nnyina ase.
Mpanimfoɔ agyae kuro apono mu ba,
mmeranteɛ agyae wɔn sankubɔ.
Yɛn akoma ahosan agyae,
yɛn asa adane abooboodie.
Yɛn abotire ayi atɔ fam.
Yɛn ara yɛnnue, na yɛayɛ bɔne.
Yei nti, na yɛn akoma atɔ piti,
yeinom ho na yɛn ani so ayɛ kusuu.
Sion bepɔ a ayɛ amamfo nti,
ɛserɛ so kraman nenam so.
Wo AWURADE, wote hɔ daa,
w’adwa tim hɔ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
Ɛdeɛn nti na wo werɛ firi yɛn ma no kyɛre saa,
na woagya yɛn dadadada yi?
AWURADE, sane yɛn bra wo nkyɛn, na yɛnsane,
ma yɛn nna nyɛ foforɔ sɛ tete deɛ no.
Anaasɛ poɔ na woapo yɛn koraa,
wo bo afu yɛn mmoroso?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
